messages:
maya: Quick sync for AeroMatrix marketplace listing + HW SKU. T-72h to embargo. Need owners for CDN assets, SI validation, legal quote, and pricing band.

liam: Ill own SI validation and the integration run. Tentative slot: tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need AeroMatrix firmware engineer on call.

nora: Got an initial asset bundle but hero is low-res. Partner said hi-res will be delivered to s3://aeromatrix-assets/marketplace/6644/ by EOD. I can accept placeholders for preview.

evan: Landing copy draft in /staging/marketplace/aeromatrix/  Ill push a final version after hero arrives. Also added SEO meta and CTA variants.

maya: Embargo set to 2026-05-18T15:00:00Z. All public assets + legal signoff required T-24h before embargo. No exceptions.

liam: SI runbook (short):
```
- git checkout release/aeromatrix-marketplace
- deploy connector v1.8.0
- run smoke: ./ci/smoke.sh --sku AM-EDGE-XL
- run integration: ./ci/integrate.sh --env staging --partner aeromatrix
- verify logs: tail -n 200 /var/log/redwood/connector.log | grep -i "handshake ok"
- upload screenshots to Partnerships/AeroMatrix/tests/
```
Fallback: if firmware incompatible we publish listing with badge "integration pending" and disable one-click deploy.

nora: Partner agreed to placeholders for preview; final hero must be 2x retina by cutover. Ill tag non-compliant images in the tracker.

evan: Marketing/legal note: need a 1-sentence partner quote (perf + partnership). @nora can you nudge them for the template?

nora: Pinged AeroMatrix marketing with template. Expect quote + hi-res by tomorrow 10:30 PT.

content-bot: preview-check started (job 14201)
content-bot: preview-check found 1 missing alt tag on hero placeholder (non-blocking)

liam: Reserved 4 GPUs for load test during integration. If load spikes, we fall back to read-only listing.

maya: Two asks to mark launch-ready: 1) @nora confirm CDN path and filenames; 2) @liam post SI run results here. If no blockers by 12:00 PT tomorrow we mark "launch-ready" and schedule final dry-run at 13:00 PT.

nora: CDN path when assets arrive: https://cdn.redwood.example/partners/aeromatrix/6644/. I will update filenames when hi-res uploaded.

liam: Will run integration at 09:30 PT tomorrow. Posting results and screenshots here. FWIW I added a quick smoke checklist to the runbook.

evan: Created analytics ticket INF-8707 to ensure partner.sku_id and partner.region are included in events. Please link any additional metrics to that ticket.

deploy-bot: preview-check succeeded  all links resolvable, meta tags present :white_check_mark:

maya: If AeroMatrix firmware fails final validation we publish listing with clear "integration pending" badge and show partner contact + docs. Legal must still approve the quote to go live.

nora: Quote received from AeroMatrix marketing. Sent to legal for review.

liam: Integration run complete  smoke + handshake OK, one non-blocking warning in connector logs. Screenshots uploaded to Partnerships/AeroMatrix/tests/run-142.

maya: Great. Legal approval pending; once legal adds "approved-for-publish" tag and marketing signs off were green. Thanks team 44d Document results in Partnerships/Marketplace/AeroMatrix/launch-playbook.md and tag approvals in the tracker.
